image_description: A top-down view of a crab, identified as a Dungeness crab, resting on a wet, rocky surface. The crab has a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-brown hue and lighter mottling. It possesses two large claws (chelipeds) at the front and multiple walking legs extending laterally. The texture appears hard and calcified, consistent with a crustacean exoskeleton.
